svg.title: GRID 50 — Impact — Blueprint (frame 05 of 05)
svg.desc: Design blueprint for the 50 GRID banknote: final note, theme, key elements, wireframe, symbol construction, colour system, patterns, SVG layers and specifications.

g.text: Impact is the value of consequence: what an action does to everything around it.
The 50 note drops one event onto a calm lattice. Dots swell at each crest and are pushed outward, weaker with
distance, never quite zero. The zero of the number is the point of impact, so the numeral itself is the cause.
Dot radius follows a damped cosine of distance from the impact point E.
Contour rings at D = n · 120 pass through every crest: the wave made visible.
E sits in the counter of the zero. The numeral is the stone, the lattice the water.
A half-cell offset lattice follows the same wave at lower amplitude: a second order effect.
Bottom rail waves gain amplitude and frequency toward the impact.
One event E lands on a
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE

The lattice is everything it reaches.
Seven flat fills, no gradients, no transparency, no effects. Every overprint is an
explicit colour layer; every pattern uses a colour from this palette only.
SECTION E · P01 – P08 · HIGHLIGHT = IN USE
SECTION B · L01 – L08 · NAMED GROUPS
Border, keylines, ruler band, corner details
Colour blocks and the large geometric composition
Guilloché, contour, hatching, micro-grids, dot systems
The denomination symbol and its construction
Watermark window, repeated symbol, supporting forms
Denomination, GRID, title, phrase, serials, microcopy
Thread, tactile code, latent image, registration, micro-elements
50 px sides · 75 px rails · 26 px frame
